value.value: Drop-cast 20 µL of NC dispersion in hexane, adjusted to absorbance 0.2 at 280 nm, on carbon-coated Cu grids. TEM uses JEM-F200 at 200 kV. Figures 3 and S2 provide corresponding SAED assignments; no universal same-particle identity across methods is established.
